action_contract_materialization.coverage: catalog action IDs must equal actions[].action_id exactly
action_contract_materialization.materialization: resolve by exact action_id before routing or response projection; do not fall back to prose defaults

action_record_defaults.mutation_expected_revision_rule: required for every existing mutated resource; new-resource actions explicitly use not_applicable
action_record_defaults.target_binding_rule: derive a concrete target from route parameters or request payload; workspace-scoped create/read actions explicitly declare workspace target
action_record_defaults.response_payload_contract: derive from action.success_response_schema and require the matching response_schema_catalog.payload_definition

target_binding_policy.read_action: target comes from route parameters or workspace scope; expected_revisions is not_applicable
target_binding_policy.existing_resource_mutation: request must include target_refs[] and expected_revisions[] with the same exact resource set for every changed existing resource; mismatch is 409 and returns refreshed targets
target_binding_policy.new_resource_mutation: request must include operation_id, target_refs=[] and expected_revisions=[] unless the action contract declares an existing parent target; the created target is materialized only inside the commit marker
target_binding_policy.new_resource_reference_target: every action whose primary_target.kind is created_resource must declare target_binding.reference_target; action references use this stable workspace, parent or input context before the created ID exists and never use created_result as a pre-commit target
target_binding_policy.selection_mutation: source/document selection snapshot ID and selection revision are required and immutable after commit; every selected existing resource is also materialized in target_refs and expected_revisions
target_binding_policy.external_attempt: Provider/release actions bind attempt ID, execution fence and dispatch/publish marker; when the server creates the attempt after a committed launch, the request need not carry attempt_ref but the commit marker must persist it before dispatch
target_binding_policy.response_target: every returned available action must carry its concrete target, target_refs, current revisions and presentation
target_binding_policy.target_ref_order: sort and deduplicate by object_type then id before request hashing or response projection
target_binding_policy.parent_target: parent targets are explicit context targets; mutations include their revision when the parent projection changes
target_binding_policy.dynamic_target: never serialize union or collection types as object_type; use a discriminated target or one target_ref per item
target_binding_policy.selection_action: selection actions are executable only after a server-issued selection_ref is materialized; singleton export may use an explicit one-item selection
target_binding_policy.conditional_target: conditional payload references enter target_refs only when the selected branch actually changes that resource

response_payload_policy.action_reference_semantic_check: resolve the exact route, request schema, response payload, target branch, selection binding and revision sources before emitting a clickable action; any mismatch is a materialization error

success_http_status_policy.override_completeness: every action must resolve to exactly one non-empty allowed status array; actions absent from action_overrides use default_by_method

rules.200: 读取、更新、同步结算、完整批量结算，或只改变 Job 为等待方向确认且未创建外部工作包
rules.201: 本次提交创建了新的持久对象；响应 result.kind=created 且 created_targets 非空
rules.202: 外部或长任务已受理但尚未完成；响应顶层 operation 和 result.status_url 必须存在
rules.207: 选择集合逐项结算且至少一项成功、至少一项拒绝或冲突；只允许选择动作使用

success_http_status_policy.conditional_status_rule: 同一动作允许多个状态时，服务端必须按实际提交结果选择；不得用 201/202 掩盖未创建或未受理

condition_language.bare_boolean_rule: a bare condition token must be listed in bare_boolean_fields; enum and numeric fields require an explicit comparison
condition_language.unknown_field_or_parse_failure: registry validation error; never interpret as otherwise

meanings.submitted: 已提交并等待结果，提交记录可核对
meanings.started_unknown: 外部执行可能已经开始，但结果未知，必须先对账
meanings.completed: 外部执行已返回结果，只能进入对应结算状态
meanings.failed: 外部执行已明确失败，只能进入对应失败结算状态

dispatch_state_policy.settled_state_rule: completed 或 failed 不能继续投影为运行中的 Packet/Analysis/Export

selection_action_policy.selection_source: server-issued selection_ref containing selection_id, selection revision and item revisions
selection_action_policy.selection_target_materialization: selection_ref.items[] is expanded into concrete target_refs[] and matching expected_revisions[]; parent targets are added only when the parent projection changes
selection_action_policy.missing_selection: action is not executable and must not be emitted as a clickable mutation reference
selection_action_policy.single_document_export: export_authoring_draft may receive an explicit one-item selection derived from the current Document revision
selection_action_policy.compile: compile_runtime is emitted only from a server-issued Document selection projection, never guessed from one Document
selection_action_policy.materialization_action: materialize_selection accepts a typed filter and optional checked target refs, creates the immutable SelectionSnapshot, and is the only client-visible way to turn a checked list into a batch selection
selection_action_policy.materialization_exception: materialize_selection is a selection-creation action and must receive selection_ref=null; it is not subject to the ordinary selection-mutation requirement

auxiliary_object_policy.selection_snapshots: immutable input records; they do not own next_action

SelectionSnapshot.projected_through: the response or list that created it

recovery_policy.before_workspace_list: run recovery_sweep before materializing any list, detail or next_action projection after process start or reopen
recovery_policy.before_action_execution: re-read the persisted target, operation and lease state after recovery_sweep; stale UI action references are rejected with 409
recovery_policy.expired_lease: an expired lease must be swept and classified before retry, reconcile or publish actions are exposed
recovery_policy.external_unknown: do not retry or duplicate an external attempt until probe/reconcile has produced an explicit retry authorization
recovery_policy.sweep_idempotency: recovery_sweep is idempotent and journaled; a second sweep may only add diagnostics or complete an unfinished marker

control_marker_resolution.pending: keep the requested state only while the control owner lease is valid; do not expose a fake terminal result
control_marker_resolution.committed: atomically settle paused_requested to paused, resume_requested to its persisted control_target_state (queued or running), or cancel_requested to cancelled before the next user projection; if the projection is still requested, sweep again and expose no success claim
control_marker_resolution.unknown: move the Job to needs_reconcile with recovery_resolution_required=true and expose reconcile_recovery; never infer pause, cancel or external dispatch success
control_marker_resolution.reconcile_route: reconcile_recovery accepts a paused_requested, resume_requested or cancel_requested Job only when control_marker_state=unknown, in addition to the ordinary needs_reconcile Job path

state_action_rules.matching_rule: for each object_type+state, evaluate rules in listed order and select the first true condition; exact duplicate conditions are invalid; an otherwise rule is permitted only as the final rule for that object_type+state
state_action_rules.overlap_policy: multiple rules for one object_type+state are allowed only when their conditions are mutually exclusive or ordered by matching_rule; no implicit fallback is permitted
state_action_rules.condition_validation: validate every field, operator and enum value before materialization; a parse failure is a contract error

user_presentation_defaults.redaction: route, method, raw IDs, hashes, revisions and proof handles are diagnostics-only

effects.query_verified_result: 只收纳已核验的外部结果
effects.retain_external_unknown: 持久化 external_unknown_closed，禁止自动重试
effects.retry_with_duplicate_warning: 只记录用户明确确认并返回 retry_allowed=true；reconcile 本身不发起重试

unknown_result.retry_gate: 只有单独的 retry action 在收到 retry_allowed=true 后才能发起新 attempt

outcomes.adopt_verified_commit: 收纳已核验 marker 后重新运行 Job reducer

user_presentation.help_zh: 编译只使用你明确选择并批准的条目。

preconditions: 原 compile operation 持久存在
expected compile operation and selection revisions match
actions.next_action_rules: create a new document selection snapshot and reference-closure hash; return compile_runtime

user_presentation.summary_zh: 选择缺少的关联条目后再编译
user_presentation.help_zh: 系统会先显示缺少什么，不要求你手动改文件路径。

actions.next_action_rules: show recent releases, their artifacts and user-safe next_action

user_presentation.summary_zh: 找回以前编译过的包
user_presentation.help_zh: 关闭工作室后也可以继续发布或回滚。

actions.next_action_rules: return release state, artifact hashes, journal summary and next_action

user_presentation.summary_zh: 查看编译或发布有没有完成
user_presentation.help_zh: 如果中断，页面会给出恢复或重试入口。

preconditions: 原始 compile manifest/proof 仍有效
actions.next_action_rules: reuse only the immutable failed manifest; changed documents require a new compile_runtime

user_presentation.summary_zh: 使用同一批已批准条目重新编译
user_presentation.help_zh: 不会悄悄加入后来修改但未重新批准的内容。

actions.next_action_rules: publish only the verified artifact with a new PublishProof

user_presentation.summary_zh: 把已编译包放入指定运行位置
user_presentation.help_zh: 发布前会再次核对包身份和文件哈希。

actions.next_action_rules: adopt a verified compile/publish marker, mark an uncommitted attempt failed, or raise pointer conflict; never replay blindly

user_presentation.summary_zh: 核对编译或发布中断的位置
user_presentation.help_zh: 系统会先核对文件和标记，不会盲目重新发布。

preconditions: 指针可验证且不是 unknown_archived
actions.next_action_rules: reuse immutable artifact with a new PublishProof; never bypass pointer checks

user_presentation.summary_zh: 重新尝试放置同一个运行包
user_presentation.help_zh: 如果发布位置发生变化，系统会要求重新核对。

preconditions: 发布基线已前进但可重新确认
actions.next_action_rules: create a new republish Release and proof; preserve the original Release

user_presentation.summary_zh: 基于当前发布状态重新准备发布
user_presentation.help_zh: 旧发布记录不会被覆盖。

preconditions: 来源 Release 完整且兼容
actions.next_action_rules: create a new rollback Release and switch pointer only by CAS

user_presentation.summary_zh: 恢复以前确认过的运行包
user_presentation.help_zh: 历史发布包不会被修改。

preconditions: 发布指针缺失、损坏或 pointer_state=unknown|conflict；不接受 unknown_archived
actions.next_action_rules: verify pointer and target directory; never guess the published result

user_presentation.summary_zh: 确认当前到底使用了哪个运行包
user_presentation.help_zh: 在核对完成前不会继续发布或回滚。

actions.next_action_rules: create or reopen the deterministic recovery case; return 201 only when a new case is created and 200 when the same case is already open; do not write runtime files or switch pointer

user_presentation.summary_zh: 把无法自动确认的发布问题交给人工处理
user_presentation.help_zh: 这一步不会自动发布，只会建立安全的处理记录。

preconditions: 存在 pointer conflict 或已打开恢复案件
actions.next_action_rules: allowed sub-actions are adopt_verified_pointer, abandon_publish_attempt and archive_unresolved_pointer

user_presentation.summary_zh: 决定如何处理无法确认的发布位置
user_presentation.help_zh: 证据不足时只会保留现状并停止自动发布。

preconditions: 目标 Candidate/Document revision 可读
actions.next_action_rules: create read-only suggestion run; never modify a Document directly

user_presentation.summary_zh: 让 AI 帮你检查、补全或润色当前条目
user_presentation.help_zh: 建议会先显示给你，点击应用后才会修改文档。

actions.next_action_rules: show unfinished and recent assistant runs with next_action

user_presentation.label_zh: 查看 AI 建议记录
user_presentation.summary_zh: 找回以前请求过的 AI 辅助
user_presentation.help_zh: 关闭工作室后也能继续查看结果。

actions.next_action_rules: return suggestion, evidence, risks and target revision

user_presentation.summary_zh: 查看 AI 对当前条目的修改建议
user_presentation.help_zh: 确认适合后再点击应用。

preconditions: Run=failed，或 reconcile_assistant_run 已返回 retry_allowed
目标 revision 和 assistant input hash 未变化
actions.next_action_rules: new attempt with the same target revision and assistant input hash

user_presentation.summary_zh: 重新让 AI 检查这一条
user_presentation.help_zh: 不会自动改动当前文档。

actions.next_action_rules: query or preserve unknown result; never silently duplicate a suggestion request

user_presentation.label_zh: 核对 AI 建议请求
user_presentation.summary_zh: 确认上次辅助请求有没有返回
user_presentation.help_zh: 未知时不会直接重复请求。

preconditions: 目标 Document revision 未变化
actions.next_action_rules: CAS-apply suggestion and invalidate approval when content changes

user_presentation.summary_zh: 把 AI 建议写入当前编辑器
user_presentation.help_zh: 应用前会检查文档是否被别人修改。
